title: Membership Tenure Courtesy on Northgate Optical Switch-Down Credits
content:
Members of long standing receive a courtesy uplift on a Northgate Optical switch-down credit. The uplift is set by how many whole months the membership on the eyewear job has been held.

**Bulletin.** Where the membership on the job has been held for at least 120 whole months, the switch-down courtesy uplift is 10 percent, and where it has been held for at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months, the uplift is 5 percent. A membership held for fewer than 60 whole months receives no switch-down courtesy uplift.

**Which membership, and how long.** The membership is the one presented on the eyewear job, as shown on the Northgate Memberships record of that membership. The months held are the whole months from that membership's opened date to the day the switch-down credit is worked out; a month that is not yet complete is not counted.

| Whole months the membership on the job has been held | Switch-down courtesy uplift |
|---|---|
| 0 to 59 | none |
| 60 | 5 percent |
| 119 | 5 percent |
| 120 | 10 percent |
| more than 120 | 10 percent |

### Notes on the tiers

- The thresholds are inclusive: exactly 60 whole months reaches the 5 percent uplift, and exactly 120 whole months reaches the 10 percent uplift.
- The membership of the patient, where the patient is a household dependent with a membership of their own, is not the membership on the job and is not read.
